text.en: The existing Quinlogan Barangay High School is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Quinlogan National High School.

All personnel, records, assets, and properties, including buildings, sites and improvements thereof, obligations and funds of the Quinlogan Barangay High School are hereby transferred to the Quinlogan National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
